title: Fintech launch position
subtitle: A grounded view before the licensing decision
source: Instant KYC runs through a partner API and the founding team is ex-Stripe. The company has no lending licence, operates in one market, and has a 12-week runway. UPI credit rails are opening and three marketplaces want an embedded offer. RBI scrutiny of NBFC partnerships is tightening and an incumbent is shipping a copy.
